title: Gary's Biefeld-Brown CCTO experiments in a garden shed
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of Gary's Biefeld-Brown CCTO experiments in a garden shed, about 2007-2026 at Gary's garden shed, UK, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm only doing these experiments in a 10x 10t shed

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space program, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he now runs his own experiments in a small garden shed, about ten feet by ten, in the UK. He says the work is based on the Biefeld-Brown effect, an old claim that devices charged with high voltage can produce a push on their own. He mentions the tiny shed to show how humble his setup is.
